detailed_description:
The target video uses gritty cinematic realism, overcast daylight, natural city colors, restrained handheld energy, readable action choreography, realistic body weight, and brief controlled motion blur during impacts. Use only the two referenced adult women; do not reproduce the white character-sheet backgrounds, reference-image divisions, or visible labels. The fight is intense but non-graphic, with no weapons, blood, serious injuries, or broken bones.

[Shot 1] A moving over-the-shoulder tracking shot follows directly behind the right shoulder of <Subject 1> as she walks along a moderately busy urban sidewalk. Her long straight black hair sways across the back of her navy sweater vest, and her blue plaid skirt moves naturally with each step. Storefronts, roadside trees, parked scooters, and passing vehicles create layered depth around her. Ahead, <Subject 2> approaches from the opposite direction, clearly visible between <Subject 1>'s shoulder and head. <Subject 2> walks forward in her oversized beige-and-blue sweater, black shorts, and dark-brown boots without moving aside. The camera maintains its over-the-shoulder composition and follows <Subject 1>'s walking speed as the distance between them rapidly closes.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the two women pass too closely and their near shoulders collide with a firm, visible impact. Both take half a step beyond each other, stop, and turn back. The camera performs a fast semicircular move into a medium two-shot perpendicular to the sidewalk. <Subject 1> (S1) looks shocked and irritated, squares her shoulders toward <Subject 2>, and shouts in a sharp youthful female voice, <d>[Chinese] 哇擦类！</d> She finishes the line, closes her mouth, steps forward, and throws one impulsive right straight punch. The fist lands against <Subject 2>'s left cheek with controlled cinematic contact; <Subject 2>'s head turns with the impact, her loose hair whipping sideways, but she remains standing.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, a close handheld three-quarter shot follows <Subject 2> recovering immediately and raising both fists. <Subject 1> attempts a wide left swing. <Subject 2> blocks it with her right forearm, counters with one compact left punch to <Subject 1>'s upper torso, then delivers one low right kick to the outside of <Subject 1>'s thigh. Each action occurs sequentially with visible preparation, contact, recoil, and recovery. <Subject 1> staggers sideways, regains her footing, and rushes forward with another wild right hook. The camera tracks laterally beside them, keeping both faces and complete upper-body actions readable while pedestrians retreat into the distant background.

[Shot 4] At 00:10.200, the shot cuts to a slightly low wide angle for the decisive exchange. <Subject 2> slips outside <Subject 1>'s incoming hook, redirects the punching arm past her shoulder, and lands one controlled right body punch. As <Subject 1> bends forward and loses balance, <Subject 2> hooks her boot behind <Subject 1>'s lead ankle and performs one clean foot sweep. <Subject 1> falls safely onto her hip and hands on the sidewalk, remaining conscious but unable to continue. <Subject 2> stays standing, steps back instead of continuing the attack, and holds a guarded stance while breathing heavily. The camera makes a short push toward <Subject 2>, then settles into a stable final composition with the victorious <Subject 2> in the foreground and the defeated <Subject 1> seated on the pavement behind her, supporting herself with one arm. The victory must be visually unambiguous.

Maintain stable facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and left-right continuity throughout every cut. Do not exchange the characters' faces or costumes. No duplicated bodies, extra limbs, fused hands, distorted joints, floating hair, disappearing clothing, simultaneous contradictory actions, excessive acrobatics, crowd interference, subtitles, or text.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous urban traffic, distant horns, footsteps, soft crowd ambience, wind through roadside trees, clothing movement, hair swishes, the shoulder collision, restrained punch and kick impacts, shoes scraping pavement, short exertion grunts, and increasingly heavy breathing. <Subject 1>'s single spoken line remains clearly audible and synchronized with her mouth. No additional dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A tense 112 BPM cinematic breakbeat with deep bass pulses, dry percussion, and a restrained distorted synth layer. The beat begins subtly under the walking shot, intensifies after the shoulder collision, accents each major impact, and ends on a low sustained hit when <Subject 2> wins. No vocals.
